sources_read.section: the centred Card with placeholder-only inputs
the task 036 seam and its transform-only variants

scope: The sign-in screen only: its layout, its form affordances and its motion. Out of scope: any auth logic (the hook's contract is unchanged apart from UI state), and the workspace shell.

acceptance_criteria.text: At lg and up the brand side renders beside the form; below lg only the form does, above the fold.
Each field has a real label; the password reveals; submit shows a pending state; an error is announced.
The entrance staggers and the motif loops; both are transform-only and settle under reduced motion.
verify green; the page's Lighthouse a11y/bp/seo are 1.00 with no failures; a real sign-in lands in the workspace.

open_questions: Whether the pilot wants the brand side at md as well; today it appears at lg, so a tablet in portrait (1024) still gets it.
Whether a 'forgot password' affordance is needed — there is no reset flow in the Lite stack, so adding a link would be a dead end; raised, not built.
risks: Adding a heading could break the outline; exactly one h1 ('Sign in') is used and the wordmark is a paragraph.
Infinite ambient animations cost frames while the page is open; they are transform-only (compositor) and disabled under reduced motion.
No UI hint carries credentials: a hint would ship to production.
